name: bws-diagram
description: Diagram pane: after a big turn a small model decides whether it is worth a diagram; if so a fork draws what happened (steps, files, new components, decisions) in a side pane with a legend. Mermaid blocks Claude writes are pinned there too. /diagram draws the whole session.

autoDiagram.title: Diagram big turns
autoDiagram.description: After a turn, ask the small model whether it was big enough to diagram, and if so draw it. Off: only /diagram and pinned mermaid blocks.

model.title: Classifier model
model.description: Model alias or id that decides whether a turn is big (haiku, sonnet, opus, or a full id).

dumpFile.title: State dump file
dumpFile.description: Diagnostic: when set, the diagram list is written to this file as JSON after every change. Empty (default): nothing is written.
